notes: The booklet is a small low-resolution picture set, so positions are my best reconstruction, not exact.

In step 8 the booklet flips the model and adds the 2x2 bricks, 2x2 plate and wheel holders to the underside. No upright layout can show that without an early piece resting on later pieces, which the rules forbid.

To keep every rests_on pointing only at earlier steps, I rebuilt the layout in a single frame. The black 2x6 plate p12 is at the bottom. The wedge p23 overhangs its front end, and the base p19, turned, rests on the wedge. Bricks p4 and p5 sit on p12's free rear end, beside the base. The wheel holders p32 and p33 sit on those bricks.
Because of that single frame, the wheel holders and bricks are not truly under the base as in the real model. The connections are the same, but the absolute heights are a reconstruction.
Plate p6 is placed on holder p32. Its exact spot is a guess.
The model is one connected build. The wheels, tyres, bucket arm, shovel and jackhammer join it through other_joins.
Vehicle base p19 is assumed to be 2 plates tall. Bar p16 is assumed to be 6 plates tall.
The minifigure (helmet, torso, legs) is not in the piece list and is omitted.
I could not tell which clip holds the shovel p14 and jackhammer p7. I assumed p14 is in the rear clip p18 and p7 sits sideways on bar p16.
Four wheels and tyres go onto the two wheel holders, two wheels per holder.
